# VRTX Fiscal 2005 Figures

## Key Figures

- **Software (2005):** $18,683 (Source: [report.md](documents/report.md))
- **Total Property and Equipment Net (2005):** $65,243 (Source: [report.md](documents/report.md))
- **Total Property and Equipment Gross (2004):** $191,019 (Source: [report.md](documents/report.md))
- **Total Property and Equipment Net (2004):** $64,225 (Source: [report.md](documents/report.md))

## Calculation

To determine what percent of the 2005 gross total property and equipment value is related to software:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Software (2005)}}{\text{Total Property and Equipment Gross (2005)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{18,683}{202,359} \right) \times 100 \approx 9.23\% \]
